CustomField.description: Whether source records in the Recycle Bin and archived tasks and events count (ALL ROWS). A deleted record counts until it is purged from the Recycle Bin (ADR-0136).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Counts records in the Recycle Bin and archived tasks and events. Deleting a record then does not lower the total; emptying the Recycle Bin does, at the next full recalculation.
CustomField.label: Include Deleted
